description: GongRzhe/Gmail-MCP-Server, run from npm. Disabled until it is set up: run 'npx @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp auth' once — it opens a Google login and writes ~/.gmail-mcp/credentials.json, which the server then finds by itself. Needs npx on the PATH of this process. Note the server's README suggests a Docker image 'mcp/gmail'; that image does not exist on Docker Hub.
